A large '''bear-like creature''' was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="Assault" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="Mycroftsystem">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Mycroft system/Legends|Mycroft system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]]. Although the creature resembled a [[black bear]], it had mottled [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and [[Limb/Legends|hands]] similar to those of a [[raccoon]]. The creature lived in an area of low, [[Forest/Legends|forest]]-covered [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]].<ref name="Assault" />

{{RPG|"[[Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|Assault on Repair Station M13]]"}}
At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Green squad|team]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents underwent a [[Assault on Repair Station M13|mission]] to the mountain-covered area of Mycroft during the planet's [[Winter/Legends|winter]] season. The black [[Bear/Legends|bear]]-like creatures were [[Diet/Legends|ravenous]] from the long, [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] harsh season and their presence in the area was a potential hindrance to the Rebel agents' mission.<ref name="Assault" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The bear-like creature was mentioned in "[[Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|Assault on Repair Station M13]]," a [[roleplaying game]] scenario written by [[Paul Murphy]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The scenario was first published in [[1988]] in the supplement ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'' and noted the creature as a potential hazard the player characters may face during the adventure.<ref name="M13">{{WEGCite|story=Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
